row.name: CRA International Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=30 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.5 tightness=0.68 base_volume_vs_leg=0.8 base_volume_vs_avg=0.96
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 30 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; the base gave back 0.5 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 5.4% vs its 20-SMA, 5.7% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: Three recorded FAILs — C (base 30 sessions, giveback 0.5 of the leg), RE (burst bar only 38% of the prior 5-bar range), and VOL (volume barely 1.05x the 50-session average against a required 1.5x for a base over 21 sessions) — drag this below A quality. The base shaded on the chart is visibly wide and overlapping across roughly 30 sessions with multiple red bars of similar size to the green ones, confirming the loose, high-giveback consolidation the numbers record. The signal bar itself is modest and not the widest recent bar, consistent with the RE failure.
claude.key_risk: Prior breakouts worked 0 of 3 in the last 60 sessions, and the base gave back half the prior leg gain, meaning there is no compressed energy to release.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal close of 174.94 or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below 172.
